Yes, Smit is my real name!

I’m a self-taught product designer who loves building digital experiences that leave a positive impact on people and help businesses grow. Most of my work sits where consumer behaviour meets business goals — loyalty, growth, and the small details that quietly decide whether someone comes back.

When I’m not designing, you’ll find me nerding-out about recent football/cricket matches, playing FIFA, clicking/editing pictures. Feel free to share your Ultimate Team ID if you also play FIFA — always up for a game. I also love exploring new places I’ve never been to (cliche, but the truth). See you around!
